items.heading: Sushi Rolls
details: Key ingredients: sushi rice, nori sheets, rice vinegar, fillings such as cucumber and fish
Cook sushi rice and season it with rice vinegar, sugar and salt.
Spread rice over a nori sheet and add fillings in a line.
Roll tightly using a bamboo mat.
Slice into pieces with a sharp, wet knife.

items.heading: Ramen
details: Key ingredients: ramen noodles, pork or chicken broth, soy sauce or miso, soft-boiled egg, green onion
Simmer bones or aromatics for hours to build a rich broth.
Season the broth with soy sauce, miso or salt as desired.
Cook fresh ramen noodles separately until just tender.
Assemble noodles in broth topped with sliced meat, egg and green onion.

items.heading: Tempura
details: Key ingredients: shrimp or vegetables, flour, cold water, egg, oil for frying
Mix a light batter from flour, egg and ice-cold water, keeping it lumpy.
Dip shrimp or vegetable pieces lightly into the batter.
Fry in hot oil until pale golden and crisp.
Drain and serve immediately with dipping sauce.

items.heading: Sushi
details: Ingredients: short-grain rice, rice vinegar, nori, fish/seafood or vegetables and soy sauce.
Cook and season the rice, cool slightly, shape with fillings or roll in nori, slice and serve with condiments.

items.heading: Okonomiyaki
details: Ingredients: main ingredient, onion/garlic or other aromatics, oil or fat, salt, spices/herbs and water/stock as needed.
Prepare and cut the main ingredients.
Sauté or toast the aromatics and spices, add the main ingredients and cook using the traditional simmering, steaming, baking or grilling method until done.
